audience: product and growth teams who read analytics, feature flags and error issues from PostHog

useCases.title: Check dashboards and their insight results
useCases.text: List the dashboards of the project. Read one dashboard to see its tiles and their latest results.

useCases.title: Find the right event name and read recent events
useCases.text: List the event names the project has seen. Then list the raw events of one name within a time range.

useCases.title: Review feature flag rollouts
useCases.text: List the feature flags with their active state. Read one flag to see its filters, rollout percentage and variants.

useCases.title: Triage error tracking issues
useCases.text: List the error tracking issues with their status and occurrence data. List the annotations, such as releases or incidents, that appear on the charts.

useCases.title: Look up a person and their properties
useCases.text: List persons, or read one person by id with all properties and linked distinct ids.
